about.label: Who we are
about.title: We bring your vision to life
about.p1: At <1>OnSight Comunicación</1> we are a passionate team of audiovisual professionals based in Madrid. We specialize in transforming ideas into memorable visual experiences that connect brands with people.
about.p2: Since our founding, we have collaborated with companies across all sectors, bringing creativity, technique, and commitment to every project. We believe every story deserves to be told in a unique and powerful way.

services.label: What we do
services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive audiovisual production tailored to your brand's needs

branded.title: Branded Content
branded.description: We create original narratives that link emotions with your brand.
branded.fullDescription: Branded Content is the most powerful way to connect with your audience because it doesn't interrupt — it seduces. We create audiovisual pieces that tell your brand's story in an authentic, emotional, and memorable way. From brand short films to social media content series, we develop creative concepts that reflect your values and resonate with your target audience.

streaming.title: Events & Streaming
streaming.description: We produce and broadcast your events in real time with the highest technical quality.
streaming.fullDescription: A well-produced event transcends its physical space. We handle the comprehensive production of your in-person events and their live broadcast: from technical and logistical planning to simultaneous streaming across multiple platforms. Congresses, conferences, product launches, corporate galas, and webinars with the image and sound quality your brand deserves. Streaming amplifies the impact of every event, reaching unlimited audiences anywhere in the world.
features: Full production of in-person and hybrid events
Simultaneous streaming to YouTube, LinkedIn, and custom platforms
Real-time graphics and lower thirds design and management
Event recording and editing for subsequent distribution

corporativos.title: Corporate Videos
corporativos.description: We reflect the values and identity of your company with the highest quality audiovisual productions.
corporativos.fullDescription: Corporate video is the most effective tool for conveying the culture, values, and purpose of your company. We produce institutional pieces that build trust with clients, partners, and investors: from company videos to product presentations, executive interviews, and internal process reports. Cinematic quality in service of your corporate image.
features: Investor pieces and audiovisual pitch decks

videomarketing.title: Funnels & Video Marketing
videomarketing.description: We produce the videos your funnel needs at every stage: from the ad that captures attention to the VSL that closes the sale.
videomarketing.fullDescription: Video is the most powerful asset within a web sales funnel. We produce specific pieces for each funnel phase: acquisition ads that generate qualified traffic, offer presentation videos for landing pages, VSL (Video Sales Letters) that argue and convert, and testimonials that eliminate objections. Each piece is designed with a clear objective within your digital sales process, ready to integrate into your landing page or funnel.
features: VSL (Video Sales Letter) for sales pages
Offer presentation videos for landing pages
Acquisition ads (Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads)
A/B testing of creatives to optimize conversion

webs.title: Websites & Hosting
webs.description: We design and develop websites, sales landing pages, and conversion funnels that turn visits into customers.
webs.fullDescription: A beautiful website that doesn't convert is money poorly invested. We design and develop result-oriented websites and conversion funnels: lead capture pages, sales landings, online stores, and corporate websites. We combine user-centered UX/UI design with conversion strategy so that every visit counts. Development in modern technologies with optimal performance and SEO positioning.
features: Web development in React, Next.js or WordPress
Sales landings and lead capture pages
SEO optimization and performance (Core Web Vitals)

creadores-hub.title: Creators Hub
creadores-hub.description: The professional studio and team you need to take your content to the next level.
creadores-hub.fullDescription: We know what a content creator needs to stand out: professional equipment, the right space, and a team that understands your style and audience. At Creators Hub we put our fully-equipped studio, high-end cameras, cinematic lighting, and all production and post-production support at your disposal so you only have to focus on creating. Whether you're a YouTuber, Instagrammer, podcaster, or TikToker, we transform your ideas into pieces that hook, grow, and monetize. From long-form YouTube videos to weekly content packs for Instagram and TikTok, we produce with you and for you.
features: Studio rental with technical equipment included
Multi-camera recording for YouTube and podcasts
Production of Reels, TikToks, and vertical content
Editing and assembly with custom graphics
Monthly content packs for social media
